description:
CALM-Scenarios
	

The roads that CALM drives on. It holds 159 real speed bump crossings, 114 from Germany and 45 from Italy, each reduced to what a simulator needs: the height of the road along the approach, the position, height and width of the bump, and what the car's camera detected on the way. It also holds the split into training and evaluation roads and a set of synthetic roads. The images and raw sensor data behind the crossings are in CALM-Germany and CALM-Italy, which are… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CALM-Dataset/CALM-Scenarios.
